button.radio-button: grouped single selection and switch button
button.checkbox-button: support grouped and single checkbox button

selector.checkbox-selector: a list of check box and can select value

navigator.navigator-base: a generic navigator which is the base of all navigators
navigator.navigator: a default navigator with automatic switch between horizontal and vertical according to the web page width.

navigation-elements.navigation-view: a view only navigation item, support url jump
navigation-elements.navigation-list: a navigation button supporting to click dropdown list
